France Witnesses Demonstrations Led by Unions Across The Country | WION Race To Power
France is bracing for a massive day of protests as students, workers and pensioners join nationwide marches and strikes. Five trade unions have called for action, with authorities expecting between 500,000 and 700,000 demonstrators across the country. The movement, which began with students protesting poor education conditions, has expanded to include workers and Yellow Vest supporters. Paris is expected to see tens of thousands of protesters.
